Container.Name: castaway
Container.Overview: Self-hosted RTMP relay. OBS pushes RTMP in on 1935, viewers watch HLS on 8080 with a connection-stats overlay (bitrate, buffer, latency, dropped frames).
Container.Description: Lightweight RTMP ingest + HLS playback. OBS streams to rtmp://<host>:1935/live/<stream-key> — viewers open http://<host>:8080/?key=<stream-key> and see the stream with a sidebar showing real-time connection diagnostics (resolution, video bitrate, bandwidth estimate, buffer health, latency, dropped frames, stall count).
